common.type_start_date_to_confirm: Type the start date, {date}, to confirm the deletion

settings.title: Settings
settings.host_pattern: Must be a valid fully qualified domain name
settings.host_format: Must be a valid fully qualified domain name
settings.public_address_tooltip: IPv4 or IPv6, announced to participants rather than bound locally, so a NAT address is correct. Detection proposes IPv4; override it when a port forward uses another.
settings.private_address_tooltip: IPv4 or IPv6, only for participants connecting from the local network: the server then announces both addresses, sparing them NAT hairpinning.
settings.address_invalid: Enter an IPv4 or IPv6 address
settings.detect_addresses_failed: The addresses could not be probed. Fill them in by hand.
settings.udp_ports_description: Audio and video travel over UDP on {range}, not over HTTPS. The rule on this node is automatic, but any router in front of it must forward the range or participants cannot connect.
settings.stun_server_tooltip: Leave empty unless you run your own. A public STUN server receives the IP address of every participant.
settings.turn_ext_server_tooltip: Participants behind a firewall that blocks UDP cannot join without TURN. This app does not provide one.
settings.turn_ext_secret_tooltip: BigBlueButton signs every client credential with the TURN server's static-auth-secret and supports no other authentication mode: without the matching value, the server refuses them all.
settings.turn_ext_secret_stored: A secret is stored. Leave empty to keep it.
settings.announce_alone: Announce being alone in the conference
settings.enable_recording_tooltip: Captures audio, video, chat, shared notes and presentations. Tell participants before you enable it. Room owners still need the recording permission in Greenlight.
settings.enable_learning_dashboard_tooltip: Reports each participant's connection time, talking time, chat messages, emojis and poll answers. Moderators open it from the participants list; the link keeps working afterwards, and whoever holds it can read the report.
settings.enable_external_videos_tooltip: A moderator can play a YouTube or media URL in sync for everyone. The server relays nothing, but every participant's browser fetches it from the third party.
settings.enable_breakout_rooms_tooltip: Each breakout room is a full meeting of its own, with its own audio conference, so a split multiplies what this node carries.
settings.show_presentation_on_join_tooltip: Every room gets a default presentation, which is also the surface the whiteboard draws over, so it is always loaded. This only decides whether its panel is open when a participant joins, or minimized until someone restores it.
settings.enable_audio_captions_tooltip: Live subtitles for participants who cannot hear. The recognition runs in each speaker's browser, not on this node. Whoever wants to read them turns them on with the CC button in the meeting.
settings.audio_captions_warning: Every participant is transcribed by their browser vendor
settings.audio_captions_warning_description: Google for Chrome and Edge, Apple for Safari. Nobody can opt out, Firefox and mobile produce nothing, and the transcript stays in recordings. Warn participants.
settings.audio_captions_language_tooltip: The language each browser is told to expect. The language actually spoken is not detected.
settings.audio_captions_language_helper: Following the browser covers a mixed audience, but a browser set to another language transcribes nonsense.
settings.welcome_footer_tooltip: Appended below the welcome message. Simple HTML is accepted.
settings.bigbluebutton_fqdn_tooltip: The name participants type. It must resolve to this server and carry a certificate the browser trusts: without one, browsers refuse microphone and camera access.
settings.sounds_language_tooltip: Language of the spoken announcements inside a conference. German and French ship with the module; the other packs are downloaded once and kept on the node.
settings.sounds_language_helper: Only the English pack is complete. Prompts a voice never recorded are spoken in English.
settings.welcome_message_tooltip: Shown in the chat when a meeting starts. Simple HTML is accepted.
settings.certificate_mismatch_title: The certificate does not match this hostname
settings.certificate_mismatch_description: Rooms still start, but every participant gets a browser warning for this address, and microphone and camera stay blocked until they accept it. Request a Let's Encrypt certificate above, or upload one for this hostname from Settings > TLS certificates.
settings.default_admin_title: The default administrator password is still in use
settings.default_admin_description: admin@nethserver.org still uses the password Nethesis,1234, which ships with the module and is therefore public. Sign in with it, create your own account with the Administrator role, then delete this one.

analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.retention_days: Kept for {days} days after the meeting ends, then deleted by the maintenance job.
analytics.policy_disabled_description: No new report is written. The ones below, if any, are deleted when their retention runs out.
analytics.no_reports_description: A report appears once a meeting has been held, and stays for as long as the retention allows.
analytics.no_reports_disabled_description: Enable the learning dashboard in Settings for the next meetings to be reported.
analytics.delete_description: This learning analytics report is deleted from the server. This cannot be undone.

recordings.title: Recordings
recordings.retention_days: Kept for {days} days after the meeting ends, then deleted by the maintenance job.
recordings.policy_disabled_description: No new recording is produced. The ones below, if any, are deleted when their retention runs out.
recordings.delete_description: This recording is deleted from the server, along with its playback link. This cannot be undone.
recordings.no_recordings_description: A recording appears once a recorded meeting has been processed, and stays for as long as the retention allows.
recordings.no_recordings_disabled_description: Enable recording in Settings for the next meetings to be recorded.
